text: ye shall cast them in the palace: Or, ye shall cast away the things of the palace
three years: Heb. three years of days
offer a sacrifice: Heb. offer by burning | this liketh: Heb. so ye love
when your gardens... increased, the palmer worm: Or, the multitude of your gardens etc. did the palmerworm etc.
after the manner: Or, in the way | have taken away your horses: Heb. with the captivity of your horses
